$comment: #VAPP-185 (epic VAPP-175, owner 2026-10-31): Settings › MCP, ONE page ×4 (web routes/t/$teamSlug/settings/mcp.tsx, desktop crates/ui/src/settings/mcp.rs, iOS McpSettingsPage.swift, Android McpSettingsScreen.kt), the SAME look everywhere: existing components only (glass groups of rows, the section label above each group, Pill, the Picker, Button, SegmentedControl, the Prompt). It REPLACES the MCP servers page: the settings-nav row `mcp` (label `title`) on every platform, phones included; the old web route `/settings/mcp-servers` redirects to `/settings/mcp` keeping its query (`?connect=`, the OAuth callback's `?mcp=…&server=`). SECTIONS in `sections` order, each a label over one glass group (no explanatory subtitles): (1) ENDPOINT: one row, the global apps endpoint `<instance>/api/mcp/apps` in mono (truncated in the middle on phones) + a `copy` button (the platform's copy + the `copied` toast). (2) SERVERS: today's MCP servers rows unchanged (name, Default pill, host; the viewer's ONE action: Connect / Set key / Reconnect / a Connected caption; the … menu), each row's caption gains `usedBy` naming the apps (alphabetical, by name) whose head package declares the server in `upstreams` (`usedByCases`); #VAPP-239 (eApps M2, @exp/emcp upstream.json `device`): a server that names a device reads `runsOn` with the device's label right after the host (`runsOnCases`: caption = host · Runs on <device> · Used by …), and an OWNER's add / edit dialog (web, desktop) carries one more row, `runsOnLabel`, THE device picker (the existing DevicePicker, row trigger) over the owner's OWN desktop apps and CLI daemons plus a first item `runsOnServer` (= no device: the server broker calls it), saved with tRPC `mcpServers.setDevice {id, deviceId}` after the row's own save (a device of another owner shows as the current value until changed); owners add / edit / remove as today. THE ADD / EDIT DIALOG's validation line (`dialogLineCases`, web `mcpDialogLine`, desktop `dialog_line`): the submit stays disabled while the draft has a problem, but a problem that is only a still-empty required field (name, URL, command) shows once the person has touched THAT field (edited or left it) or tried to submit; every other problem shows at once. Phones (no add/edit there) show the rows and the member's own Connect / Disconnect. (3) CLIENTS: the MCP clients (OAuth clients a member authorized: tRPC `mcpClients.list {teamId, scope}`); owners see a SegmentedControl `scopes` (Mine | Everyone) above the group, members only Mine and no control. A row = the client's name (its icon when it has one, else the concept `settings-mcp`), caption = `clientCaption` (`clientCaptionCases`: Everyone prefixes the member's name; the kinds, `builtin` first; the apps grant's access; `lastUsed` = the compact list relative time (`just now · 5m · 2h · 3d`) or `never`), trailing a `revoke` button (outline, small) asking the prompts.json `revoke-mcp-client` prompt; a member revokes only their own, an owner anyone's in Everyone. Empty = empty-state.json `mcp-clients`. (4) ACCESS (only when the team has an app exposing tools): ONE glass group PER APP (alphabetical by name; its header row = the app's glyph + name + `toolCount` caption), rows = the members (owners: every member, by name; a member: only their own row), each with the avatar, the name and the level: owners pick it with THE Picker over `levels` (labels in order), members read the label. Below the groups one row `activity` (chevron) opens the ACTIVITY page. (5) BUILT-IN (EXP-1657), last: ONE band PER TOOL GROUP (contract `expToolDisplay.groups`, in order), each a GlassSectionHeader whose label is the group's `label` (Work, Tracker, Team, Agents, Sessions, Apps, Activity) over one glass group listing that group's op rows exactly as before (the Exponential mark, the contract title, the muted blurb, the wire name only as a tooltip), in contract table order; a row's group = the group naming the tool it belongs to (the verb by its own name, a noun's op by `<noun>_`, the longest tool name wins: `sessions_send` is Work), and a retired row (`aliasOf`, the old `team_config_*` rows kept so old transcripts render) is never listed. The FIRST band's header carries the one filter field (placeholder `builtinFilter`, test id `mcp-builtin-tools-filter`) at its trailing edge; it filters EVERY band (a case-insensitive substring of the title, the blurb or the wire name, trimmed; blank = all), a band with no match hides (its header too), and the first VISIBLE band's header carries the field so it never disappears; every band filtered away = the ONE empty state (empty-state.json `builtin-tools-no-match`) under a header labelled `labels.builtin` carrying the field. `builtinCases` replay ×4: per query the bands shown (id, label, row count, and for a narrow query the wire names in order). ACTIVITY (`activityPage`, its own page, title `activity`, back to MCP): the `mcp_calls` rows newest first (tRPC `mcpActivity.list {teamId}`; owners: the team's calls, a member: their own; 90 days), a row = the tool name in mono, caption = `activityCaption` (`activityCaptionCases`: the app's name or `builtinApp`, the member (owners only), the client or `firstParty`, the compact relative time), trailing a Pill with the `statusLabels` word of its status. Empty = empty-state.json `mcp-activity`. `testIds` = the anchors every client's capture and test use.
